name: hoja
description: Evidence-checked tasks and session observability for Claude Code: Trebol's TaskManage and task gate, Hoja issue sync, and session traces (turns, model calls, token usage, every tool call and gate block) attached to the Hoja issue the work belongs to.

hoja_api_url.title: Hoja GraphQL URL
hoja_api_url.description: Hoja GraphQL endpoint, e.g. https://hoja.example.com/graphql (https:// is added if you leave it out). Leave empty to use HOJA_API_URL / LINEAR_API_URL from the environment.

hoja_mcp_url.title: Hoja MCP URL
hoja_mcp_url.description: Hosted Hoja MCP endpoint for the full Hoja API tools (issues, comments, decisions…), e.g. https://hoja.example.com/mcp. Leave empty to use HOJA_MCP_URL, or derive it from the GraphQL endpoint's host.

hoja_token.title: Hoja API token
hoja_token.description: Personal API token. Leave empty to use HOJA_TOKEN / LINEAR_TOKEN from the environment.

hoja_project.title: Default Hoja project
hoja_project.description: Project used when neither the chat (hoja_project select) nor the repository's .pi/config/hoja.json names one.

task_enforcement.title: Task enforcement
task_enforcement.description: block (Trebol default): non-read-only tools are refused until a TaskManage task is in_progress and active. advise: nudge only. off: no gate.

trace_upload.title: Session trace upload
trace_upload.description: When this session's trace (turns, model calls, token usage, tool calls, gate blocks, subagents) is attached to Hoja. completion: to a task's issue when the task completes. session-end: also to every linked issue when the session ends. manual: only with /hoja:trace upload. off: never (traces are still saved locally).

trace_detail.title: Session trace detail
trace_detail.description: full: whole prompts, tool inputs and outputs and model responses, with secrets scrubbed (trimmed head-and-tail only past the upload limit). metadata: names, timings, statuses and token counts only, like Claude Code's own telemetry defaults.
